title: DORIAN // LLEVAME // MASTER CLOSURE CASE
content: Independent client-production case. Artist/project: Dorian. Producer: Edwing. Boundary: do not inherit KXTXR identity, aesthetics, history, release strategy, references or objectives. Objective: conclude a balanced master for delivery to Dorian using minimum justified perturbation. Measured from the user-provided MP3 representation: duration 218.56655 s; codec MP3; 44.1 kHz; stereo; ~320149 bps; integrated loudness -9.4 LUFS; loudness range 8.8 LU; true peak +0.6 dBFS. OBSERVED: the encoded master has true-peak overs above 0 dBTP and retains material macro-dynamic contrast. DERIVED: downstream lossy reconstruction can increase clipping risk. INFERRED: present evidence does not justify rebuilding the master; minimum technical perturbation is to return to the lossless source, adjust only final true-peak limiter/output ceiling toward approximately -1.0 dBTP, render lossless, re-measure, and perform A/B plus translation checks. RIVAL HYPOTHESIS: broader tonal/dynamic remaster may still be required, but current aggregate measurements cannot establish this without Dorian-approved references and translation evidence. INVARIANTS: Dorian identity, mix intent, internal hierarchy, meaningful dynamic contrast. DECLARED EXCLUSIONS: KXTXR inheritance, unjustified aesthetic modification, overprocessing. EXPECTED RETURN: true peak controlled, loudness/macro-dynamics materially stable, no new limiter artifacts, translation stable. STATUS: AWAITING_MINIMAL_PERTURBATION_AND_RETURN.
